decisions.selected: Measure whether the assigned issue leaves the unlabeled state.
alternatives: Measure label accuracy or maintainer corrections.
decisions.rationale: The workflow explicitly targets reducing the unlabeled issue percentage; accuracy requires a human judgment contract that the workflow does not freeze.

decisions.selected: One issue needing triage per run.
alternatives: A run-level count of labels applied.
decisions.rationale: An issue is the repository outcome named by the objective, while counts and reports measure activity or output volume.

decisions.selected: Use issue event or case issue; otherwise oldest open unlabeled issue at run creation.
alternatives: Assign by run ID modulo all issues.
decisions.rationale: Event and archived case data are strongest; the deterministic historical fallback preserves an issue opportunity without treating run identity as value.

decisions.selected: Issue labels reconstructed at the evidence cutoff from the issue snapshot and label events.
decisions.rationale: Reversing post-cutoff label events provides an as-of state and keeps unavailable API evidence null.
Scheduled runs recur every six hours and maintainers may correct labels after automation; a fixed horizon makes observations stable.

decisions.selected: Binary value: one or more labels is 1, zero labels is 0.
decisions.rationale: The binary metric directly measures removal from the unlabeled state and excludes activity volume and agent judgment.
The workflow was first introduced in the adoption commit, and the checkout contains no independently frozen pre-adoption issue-label snapshots under the same evidence contract.
A single direct attainment metric is sufficient; additional counts would risk confusing activity with operational value.

uncertainties.description: Scheduled and manual runs may have multiple eligible issues when archived case and event fields are absent.
uncertainties.mitigation: Use the oldest eligible issue at run creation and preserve repeated opportunity keys.

uncertainties.description: GitHub issue events can be unavailable or paginated beyond the collected page.
No comparable pre-adoption baseline is frozen.
